cards.headline: Police investigate at Port St. Lucie Pollo Tropical, subject taken into custody
cards.teaser: Port St. Lucie police investigated an incident Saturday evening at a Pollo Tropical on NW St. Lucie West Boulevard, with crime scene tape surrounding the restaurant and a heavy law
cards.body:
Port St. Lucie police investigated an incident Saturday evening at a Pollo Tropical on NW St. Lucie West Boulevard, with crime scene tape surrounding the restaurant and a heavy law enforcement presence at the scene. Photos and videos from the location show multiple officers investigating, with one photo showing a subject in custody. The incident prompted traffic delays in the area as authorities worked to process the scene.

 Authorities requested that drivers use an alternate route if possible and allow extra time to reach their destinations. The heavy police presence and crime scene tape surrounding the restaurant created significant disruption to traffic flow on NW St. Lucie West Boulevard during the evening hours.

 There is no known threat to the public at this time, according to Port St. Lucie police. Authorities said the incident appears to be isolated, indicating that the public should not be concerned about ongoing danger in the area. The nature of the incident that prompted the large police response has not been disclosed by investigators.

 The Port St. Lucie Police Department said additional information will be released as it becomes available. The investigation remained active Saturday evening as officers continued to work at the Pollo Tropical location. No further details about the subject taken into custody or the circumstances that led to the police response have been made public at this time.

 Authorities requested that drivers use an alternate route if possible and allow extra time to reach their destinations. The heavy police presence and crime scene tape surrounding the restaurant created significant disruption to traffic flow on NW St. Lucie West Boulevard during the evening hours.

 There is no known threat to the public at this time, according to Port St. Lucie police. Authorities said the incident appears to be isolated, indicating that the public should not be concerned about ongoing danger in the area. The nature of the incident that prompted the large police response has not been disclosed by investigators.

 The Port St. Lucie Police Department said additional information will be released as it becomes available. The investigation remained active Saturday evening as officers continued to work at the Pollo Tropical location. No further details about the subject taken into custody or the circumstances that led to the police response have been made public at this time.
